answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 44275 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to accept the Gifts, attend the functions and receptions of non-Muslims which may be Haram or Halal? Question: Is it permissible to accept the Gifts, attend the functions and receptions of non-Muslims which may be Haram or Halal? Answer ID: 44275 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 497/497/M=1434) A Muslim can accept gifts from a non-Muslim provided it involves no evil. It is also allowable to participate in their party and function if you do not have to commit any act against Shariah: ولا باس بالذھاب الی ضیافۃ اھل الذمۃ (الفتاوی الھندیۃ 5/426، بیروت) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
